  "description": "Hatlab Ice Cream Delite is a hospitality organization that specializes in the production, wholesale and retail of traditional Italian gelato and other complimentary pastries.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Supervisor / Manager&nbsp;

Job Location: Osogbo, Osun
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a Supervisor / Manager to oversee the operations of our outlets in Osogbo.
	This is a hands-on management role for someone with proven experience supervising an outlet, managing staff, driving sales and taking responsibility for daily business operations.


Key Responsibilities
Outlet Management:


	Take full responsibility for the day-to-day operations of the Osogbooutlets.
	Supervise and coordinate outlet staff and ensure effective allocation of duties.
	Monitor daily sales, customer service, stock, cash handling and general outlet performance.
	Ensure company procedures, hygiene standards and operational standards are consistently maintained.
	Identify operational problems and take appropriate action to resolve them.


Sales &amp; Business Growth:


	Drive daily and monthly sales performance and work towards achieving set targets.
	Analyse sales performance and identify areas requiring improvement.
	Develop and implement practical strategies to increase sales and customer retention.
	Identify new markets and revenue opportunities within Osogboand surrounding areas.


B2B&nbsp;&nbsp;Business Development:


	Actively identify and pursue B2B sales opportunities.
	Develop relationships with schools, offices, hotels, restaurants, event organisers, retailers and other potential business customers.
	Generate leads, make business contacts, present the company&#39;s products and follow up on opportunities.
	Convert prospects into regular and profitable business accounts.
	Maintain proper records of business development activities and results.


Staff Management:


	Supervise, train and manage outlet staff to ensure productivity and compliance with company standards.
	Monitor attendance, punctuality, performance and conduct.
	Address performance and disciplinary issues appropriately.
	Maintain a professional and productive working environment.


Stock &amp; Cash Control:


	Ensure proper monitoring and control of inventory.
	Ensure timely replenishment and prevent unnecessary stock-outs.
	Monitor stock movement, conduct stock checks and investigate discrepancies.
	Ensure accurate daily sales and cash/POS reconciliation.
	Take appropriate measures to minimise wastage, losses and revenue leakages.


Customer Service:


	Ensure a consistently high standard of customer service.
	Handle customer complaints and resolve issues professionally.
	Monitor customer feedback and identify opportunities for service improvement.


Reporting:


	Prepare and submit regular reports on sales, stock, staff performance and outlet operations.
	Provide Management with timely updates on challenges, opportunities and actions taken.
	Track and report on B2B leads, prospects, conversions and business generated.


Requirements


	Minimum of 2 years of proven experience in outlet management, retail, hospitality, food service, restaurant, caf&eacute;, QSR, supermarket or a similar customer-facing business.
	Proven experience supervising and managing staff.
	Demonstrable experience in driving sales and achieving business targets.
	Experience in stock and cash control.
	Strong customer service and problem-solving skills.
	Strong communication and reporting skills.
	Ability to work independently and take ownership of outlet performance.
	Must have practical experience in business development, sales prospecting or B2B sales.
	Must be commercially minded and results-oriented.
	Must be willing to work across the company&#39;s Osogbooutlets.


Important:


	We are looking for someone with actual supervisory/management experience and a proven ability to take responsibility for business operations.


Salary
N100,000 - N120,000 monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: admin@hatlabgelao.com using &quot;Application for Outlet Supervisor/Manager &ndash; Osogbo&quot; as the subject of the mail.

Supervisor / Manager Job at Hatlab Ice Cream Delite Limited




        
    

        
        Hatlab Ice Cream Delite is a hospitality organization that specializes in the production, wholesale and retail of traditional Italian gelato and other complimentary pastries.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Supervisor / Manager 

Job Location: Osogbo, Osun
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a Supervisor / Manager to oversee the operations of our outlets in Osogbo.
	This is a hands-on management role for someone with proven experience supervising an outlet, managing staff, driving sales and taking responsibility for daily business operations.


Key Responsibilities
Outlet Management:


	Take full responsibility for the day-to-day operations of the Osogbooutlets.
	Supervise and coordinate outlet staff and ensure effective allocation of duties.
	Monitor daily sales, customer service, stock, cash handling and general outlet performance.
	Ensure company procedures, hygiene standards and operational standards are consistently maintained.
	Identify operational problems and take appropriate action to resolve them.


Sales & Business Growth:


	Drive daily and monthly sales performance and work towards achieving set targets.
	Analyse sales performance and identify areas requiring improvement.
	Develop and implement practical strategies to increase sales and customer retention.
	Identify new markets and revenue opportunities within Osogboand surrounding areas.


B2B  Business Development:


	Actively identify and pursue B2B sales opportunities.
	Develop relationships with schools, offices, hotels, restaurants, event organisers, retailers and other potential business customers.
	Generate leads, make business contacts, present the company's products and follow up on opportunities.
	Convert prospects into regular and profitable business accounts.
	Maintain proper records of business development activities and results.


Staff Management:


	Supervise, train and manage outlet staff to ensure productivity and compliance with company standards.
	Monitor attendance, punctuality, performance and conduct.
	Address performance and disciplinary issues appropriately.
	Maintain a professional and productive working environment.


Stock & Cash Control:


	Ensure proper monitoring and control of inventory.
	Ensure timely replenishment and prevent unnecessary stock-outs.
	Monitor stock movement, conduct stock checks and investigate discrepancies.
	Ensure accurate daily sales and cash/POS reconciliation.
	Take appropriate measures to minimise wastage, losses and revenue leakages.


Customer Service:


	Ensure a consistently high standard of customer service.
	Handle customer complaints and resolve issues professionally.
	Monitor customer feedback and identify opportunities for service improvement.


Reporting:


	Prepare and submit regular reports on sales, stock, staff performance and outlet operations.
	Provide Management with timely updates on challenges, opportunities and actions taken.
	Track and report on B2B leads, prospects, conversions and business generated.


Requirements


	Minimum of 2 years of proven experience in outlet management, retail, hospitality, food service, restaurant, café, QSR, supermarket or a similar customer-facing business.
	Proven experience supervising and managing staff.
	Demonstrable experience in driving sales and achieving business targets.
	Experience in stock and cash control.
	Strong customer service and problem-solving skills.
	Strong communication and reporting skills.
	Ability to work independently and take ownership of outlet performance.
	Must have practical experience in business development, sales prospecting or B2B sales.
	Must be commercially minded and results-oriented.
	Must be willing to work across the company's Osogbooutlets.


Important:


	We are looking for someone with actual supervisory/management experience and a proven ability to take responsibility for business operations.


Salary
N100,000 - N120,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Application for Outlet Supervisor/Manager – Osogbo" as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Job Openings at KPMG
content:
KPMG is a global network of independent professional services firm with deep expertise in the provision of audit, tax and advisory services to clients in various industries and sectors of the economy. The Firm is well represented in Nigeria and across the African continent, with the objective of providing exceptional and quality services to multinational, regional and local clients and to enhance the product offerings in certain previously under-serviced markets.

We are currently recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the following positions below:

1.) Platform Transformation Lead (MS/SN/SAP/Oracle) 

Job Location: Lagos
     

            
    



Key roles and responsibilities
Platform Revenue and Pursuit Leadership (45%):


	Own a personally accountable revenue target for platform transformation mandates, with attribution across Microsoft, ServiceNow, SAP, and Oracle alliance pipelines.
	Lead the pursuit of large platform transformation deals - ERP modernisation, cloud migration, platform consolidation, ServiceNow enterprise deployments - from qualification to signature.
	Serve as the senior KPMG technical and commercial authority in all platform-related client engagements and negotiations.
	Maintain active relationships with platform alliance partner teams (Microsoft, ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle) to ensure KPMG is positioned for co-sell and referral opportunities.
	Work with the Enterprise / Solution Architecture Leads (Block B) to ensure all platform proposals are technically sound and delivery-ready before contract signature.


Delivery Ownership and Quality (35%):


	Maintain ultimate accountability for delivery outcomes on platform transformation mandates within the portfolio, including client satisfaction, schedule adherence, and margin.
	Lead multi-disciplinary delivery teams including KPMG consultants, alliance partner technical resources, and specialist subcontractors.
	Enforce consistent delivery methodology, RAID discipline, and commercial governance on all platform engagements.
	Escalation points for delivery risk, scope disputes, and commercial variations; authority to mobilise additional resources or change engagement structure where needed.
	Collaborate with Block E (Enablement) to build and maintain reusable platform delivery accelerators, templates, and methodology assets.


Alliance and Ecosystem Development (20%):


	Actively manage KPMG's relationships with platform alliance partners, attending partner events, maintaining certifications, and participating in joint go-to-market planning.
	Contribute to platform-specific thought leadership, including white papers, client briefings, and industry presentations.
	Develop and grow the platform transformation capability within the T&I team, identifying skill gaps and supporting hiring and development decisions.
	Represent KPMG T&I in alliance partner advisory councils, partner conferences, and ecosystem events.


Requirements
Academic/ Professional qualifications and Experience:


	Relevant degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or Engineering.
	Certification on at least one primary alliance platform (Microsoft Azure/M365, ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist, SAP S/4HANA, or Oracle Cloud) required.
	Minimum 12 years of experience in enterprise platform consulting, with at least 5 years at Director or equivalent level.
	Proven track record of delivering large-scale platform transformation programmes (ERP, cloud, ITSM) for enterprise or government clients in Africa.
	Experience managing alliance partner relationships in a revenue-generating context.
	Proficiency in English; French an advantage.


Technical competencies & Personal attributes:


	Demonstrate and articulate KPMG values as well as proven capability in:
	Platform depth: recognised technical authority on at least one major enterprise platform with credible cross-platform knowledge.
	Alliance management: proven ability to activate and leverage technology alliances to originate and win deals.
	Commercial acumen: able to structure platform engagements for commercial viability and margin protection.
	Delivery leadership: comfortable owning large, complex platform programmes across multiple markets and delivery teams.
	Client influence: able to advise clients on platform strategy at CTO, CIO, and CFO level.
	Collaborative mindset: able to work across KPMG member firms and external alliance partner teams.
	Market Intelligence: Demonstrate commercial awareness with sound knowledge of matters affecting the market.
	Business development: entrepreneurial mind-set and ability to identify opportunities and develop high quality proposals.
	Personal effectiveness - Excellent report-writing and presentation skills.
	People management - Leadership & management skills.
	Performance management - Be a performance manager to the team in line with performance management guidelines.
	Risk management-lead in ensuring full compliance with KPMG quality & risk management requirements
	Capacity building - Takes a lead in building capability of team to future proof workforce and full utilization of existing workforce.


Benefits
We offer:


	An exciting opportunity to work with a Big 4 firm on cutting edge clients across Africa.
	Continuous learning and development.
	Exposure to multi-disciplinary client service teams.
	Unrivalled space to grow and be innovative.
	Opportunity for international travel.


Click here to apply online

 

2.) Alliance Market Lead - ServiceNow

Job Location: Lagos
Job Type: Full Time 

Position Summary


	The Alliance Market Lead – ServiceNow is an Associate director-level role responsible for converting KPMG's ServiceNow Elite Partner status into a consistent, growing stream of signed, delivering, revenue-generating engagements across Africa.
	This role manages the commercial relationship with ServiceNow, develops the joint pipeline, shapes complex ServiceNow-led opportunities into KPMG propositions, and drives the bid-to-close process for all ServiceNow alliance-originated deals.
	The Alliance Market Lead is personally accountable for ServiceNow alliance-attributed revenue at maturity and is KPMG's primary commercial relationship owner with ServiceNow's partner organisation.


Key roles and responsibilities
ServiceNow Alliance Pipeline Development (50%):


	Own and develop KPMG's ServiceNow alliance pipeline across Africa - maintaining a live, qualified pipeline of opportunities valued at 3–5× personal revenue target.
	Build and maintain relationships with ServiceNow's partner sales team, solution consultants, industry executives, and alliance managers across African markets.
	Attend ServiceNow partner forums, Knowledge conference, and joint account planning sessions as KPMG's primary commercial representative.
	Identify and qualify ServiceNow-led opportunities - positioning KPMG for SecOps, IRM, ITSM, HR Service Delivery, and Customer Service Management implementations.
	Develop joint go-to-market propositions with ServiceNow that leverage KPMG's Elite Partner status and differentiated delivery capability.


Deal Shaping and Commercial Conversion (35%):


	Shape complex ServiceNow opportunities into commercially viable KPMG propositions - working with the ServiceNow Architecture Lead (Block B) to ensure solutions are technically sound and deliverable.
	Lead proposal development, commercial structuring, and bid management for ServiceNow alliance-originated opportunities.
	Manage the end-to-end bid-to-close process - coordinating KPMG's pursuit team, ServiceNow deal desk, and client stakeholders.
	Ensure clean pipeline-to-delivery handoffs - handing signed engagements to the delivery team with a clear scope, budget, delivery model, and alliance support plan.
	Maintain accurate pipeline forecasts and conversion rate tracking for the T&I leadership team.


Elite Partner Governance and Relationship Management (15%):


	Manage KPMG's ServiceNow Elite Partner relationship - including partner agreement compliance, deal registration, certification tracking, and partner performance metrics.
	Coordinate with the ServiceNow Architecture Lead to ensure KPMG's technical delivery capability supports Elite Partner certification requirements.
	Participate in ServiceNow's partner advisory board and Elite Partner governance processes.
	Contribute to KPMG's ServiceNow joint business planning process, including annual planning and quarterly business reviews with ServiceNow's partner team.


Academic / Professional qualifications and Experience


	Relevant Degree in Business, Technology, or a related field.
	Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology sales, business development, or alliance management, with at least 5 years in a ServiceNow partner ecosystem context.
	ServiceNow Sales certifications preferred (Accredited Sales Engineer or equivalent).
	Proven track record of personally originating and closing ServiceNow-led technology deals.
	Deep understanding of ServiceNow's partner programme, Elite Partner requirements, and commercial incentive structures.
	Established network within ServiceNow's partner and enterprise sales organisation.


Technical competencies & Personal attributes:


	Demonstrate and articulate KPMG values as well as proven capability in:
	Alliance fluency: expert understanding of ServiceNow's partner commercial model, Elite Partner programme, and co-sell dynamics.
	Commercial drive: motivated by pipeline development and revenue conversion - comfortable with hard targets and regular performance measurement.
	Deal shaping able to structure complex ServiceNow opportunities into commercially viable, delivery-ready KPMG propositions.
	Relationship management: builds trusted relationships with ServiceNow partner teams and client decision-makers at CIO and CDO level.
	Collaboration: bridges the commercial and technical worlds - works closely with ServiceNow Architecture Leads and delivery teams.
	Market knowledge: understands the ServiceNow market dynamics, competitive landscape, and customer adoption patterns in African markets.
	Market Intelligence: Demonstrate commercial awareness with sound knowledge of matters affecting the market.
	Business development entrepreneurial mind-set and ability to identify opportunities and develop high quality proposals.
	Personal effectiveness - Excellent report-writing and presentation skills.
	People management - Leadership & management skills.
	Performance management - Be a performance manager to the team in line with performance management guidelines.
	Risk management-lead in ensuring full compliance with KPMG quality & risk management requirements
	Capacity building - Takes a lead in building capability of team to future proof workforce and full utilization of existing workforce.


Click here to apply online

 

3.) Cyber Transformation Lead (Alliance-Led)

Job Location: Lagos
Job Type: Full Time 

Job Summary


	The Cyber Transformation Lead is an Associate director-level role accountable for converting KPMG's Microsoft Security and Cyber alliance pipeline into signed, delivering, revenue-generating engagements across Africa.
	This role combines senior client-facing presence with deep cybersecurity transformation expertise - owning the end-to-end pursuit and delivery of cybersecurity mandates including SOC deployments, IAM programmes, Zero Trust architectures, and cyber resilience frameworks.
	The role is a primary revenue contributor within Block A, personally accountable for alliance-attributed cyber revenue and acting as the senior KPMG face to Microsoft's security partner ecosystem.


Base location:


	Your location will be determined based on your location. Our main hubs are located in Johannesburg, Lagos and Nairobi.


Key roles and responsibilities
Cyber Pipeline Conversion and Revenue Ownership (45%):


	Own a personally accountable cyber revenue target within the T&I business, with primary attribution to Microsoft Security and Cyber alliance-originated opportunities.
	Lead all major cyber transformation pursuits from client qualification through to contract signature, serving as the most senior technical and commercial voice in client meetings.
	Develop and maintain relationships with Microsoft's security partner team, cloud solution architects, and alliance managers to maintain a healthy joint pipeline.
	Shape complex cyber mandates - SOC buildouts, IAM transformations, Zero Trust programmes - into commercially viable, KPMG-deliverable propositions.
	Collaborate with the Alliance Market Lead – Microsoft (Block D) to ensure all cyber pipeline is progressed with the appropriate commercial rigour and bid investment.


Delivery Leadership (35%):


	Lead the delivery of large-scale cybersecurity transformation programmes, including oversight of multi-disciplinary delivery teams, alliance partner resources, and specialist subcontractors.
	Personally accountable for delivery quality, client satisfaction, and margin on all cyber mandates within the portfolio.
	Enforce RAID discipline and escalation protocols on all engagements; intervene early on commercial or technical risk.
	Maintain a library of KPMG-owned cyber delivery assets, methodologies, and accelerators - working with Block E to codify and scale these.
	Represent KPMG T&I as the senior technical authority in client steering committees and executive project boards.


Market and Alliance Development (20%):


	Contribute to KPMG's cybersecurity thought leadership, publishing insights, speaking at industry events, and building KPMG's profile in the African cyber community.
	Support the development of go-to-market propositions with Microsoft that differentiate KPMG in the African market.
	Mentor and develop the cybersecurity capability within the broader T&I team, building delivery depth and technical credibility.
	Contribute to the annual T&I planning process with pipeline forecasts, headcount recommendations, and market intelligence.


Requirements
Academic/ Professional qualifications and Experience:


	Relevant Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical field.
	CISSP, CISM, or equivalent cybersecurity certification required.
	Microsoft Security certifications (SC-100, SC-200 or equivalent) strongly preferred.
	Minimum 12 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 5 years in a client-facing consulting or advisory role.
	Proven experience delivering cybersecurity transformation programmes (SOC, IAM, Zero Trust, Cyber Resilience) for major enterprise or government clients in Africa.
	Demonstrated track record of working within Microsoft's partner ecosystem to originate and deliver cyber solutions.


Technical competencies & Personal attributes:


	Deep technical authority in cybersecurity with the credibility to lead client conversations at CISO and Board level.
	Alliance fluency: comfortable navigating Microsoft partner processes, co-sell motions, and alliance governance.
	Commercial mindset: able to translate technical capability into commercially structured, margin-protected proposals.
	Delivery ownership: personally comfortable owning large cyber programmes end-to-end, not just advising.
	Communication and influence: able to articulate cyber risk and transformation priorities to non-technical executives.
	Multicultural agility: able to operate across multiple African jurisdictions and client cultures.
	Stakeholder management: provide support to various management and leadership levels, as well as work well independently.
	Personal effectiveness - Excellent report-writing and presentation skills.
	People management - Leadership & management skills.
	Performance management - Be a performance manager to the team in line with performance management guidelines.
	Risk management-lead in ensuring full compliance with KPMG quality & risk management requirements
	Capacity building - Takes a lead in building capability of team to future proof workforce and full utilization of existing workforce.

HSE Officer Job at First Class Group Limited




        
    

        
        First Class Group Limited is a corporate services and utilityfirm specializingin cooling support services, HVAC systems, and mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) infrastructure solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HSE Officer 

Job Location: Nigeria
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced HSE Officer to join our dynamic team.
	The ideal candidate will ensure the workplace complies with all relevant health, safety, and environmental regulations and standards to protect employees, visitors, and the facility's assets.


Responsibilities


	Compile safety programs.
	Regularly inspect equipment and site.
	Practice safe working techniques.
	Implement and maintain health and safety standards.
	Establish a cordial and professional relationship with employees.
	Maintain compliance with all safety regulations.
	Conduct regular toolbox meetings to share best practice techniques.
	Standardize health and safety to remain consistent.
	Identify hazardous waste and dispose of it correctly.
	Compile and maintain relevant registers to ensure compliance.
	Document staff information, minutes of meetings, and reports compiled for management.
	Ensure Technicians are wearing the correct PPE.
	Monitor technicians.


Relevant Work Experience / Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor's Degree / HND qualification with 3 - 5 years of work experience.
	Certification in HSE, ISO, and NEBOSH is a plus.


Salary
N180,000 - N200,000 monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "HSE Officer" as the subject of the email.

Our services are designed to help businesses and organizations streamline their payment processing and collection operations, providing a convenient and secure way for customers to pay for goods and services.

We provide secure and efficient payment processing and collection services across all payment channels to help increase financial service depth and touch the lives of people even at the grassroot.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Android Engineer 

Job Locations: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Position Summary


	The Android Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining secure, scalable, and high-performance Android mobile applications that support the company's digital financial products and services.
	The role involves collaborating with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Backend Engineers, QA Engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver exceptional user experiences while ensuring regulatory compliance, security, and reliability in PayZeep


Key Responsibilities


	Design, build and maintain features for the Payzeep Android application.
	Write clean, tested, maintainable Kotlin/Java code.
	Integrate with backend APIs and third-party payment/SDK services.
	Participate in code review, sprint planning and technical design discussions.
	Diagnose and fix production issues affecting the Android app.
	Implement security best practices for mobile payment applications.
	Implement secure integrations with banking systems, payment processors, wallets, and financial service providers.
	Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following industry best practices.
	Conduct code reviews and maintain coding standards within the engineering team.
	Monitor application performance and troubleshoot production issues.
	Optimize mobile applications for speed, reliability, and scalability.
	Implement mobile application security best practices, including encryption, secure storage, certificate pinning, and secure authentication mechanisms.
	Support CI/CD pipelines for automated building, testing, and deployment of Android applications.
	Manage application releases through Google Play Store and enterprise distribution channels.
	Maintain version control and deployment processes.
	Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions.


Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (required).
	Relevant Android certifications are an added advantage.


Experience:


	Total Relevant Experience: 7+ years of Android application development experience.
	Experience with Unit Testing, UI Testing, and Integration Testing.
	Fintech / Financial Services Experience: 5+ years building mobile apps in fintech or a regulated environment preferred


Skills & Competences:


	Strong Kotlin/Java and Android SDK proficiency
	Experience integrating REST/GraphQL APIs and payment SDKs
	Understanding of mobile security best practices (secure storage, certificate pinning)
	Familiarity with CI/CD for mobile release pipelines
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
	High attention to detail and commitment to software quality
	Strong customer-centric mindset.
